meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你的要求操作 Git:把改动拆成原子提交、做 rebase 或 squash,或追查某段代码是哪次提交、谁改的,并在回答里给出所用命令作为证据。普通改代码不会触发它。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码,或需要追查 Git 历史(如 blame、bisect、reflog)时触发;只做普通代码编辑时不接管。

say.text: 把当前改动按模块拆成几个提交
say.note: 先看完整 diff,再分组提交并报告哈希
用 blame 给出提交哈希、作者和文件行号

say.text: 用 fixup 把这两个提交合并掉

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can stage and commit changes in atomic groups, rebase or squash branch history, and investigate Git history (blame, bisect, reflog), citing the exact commands it ran. Plain code edits don't trigger it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a Git-history investigation (blame, bisect, reflog). It stays out of ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into a few commits by module
say_en.note: Reads the full diff, then groups and commits
Uses git blame, returns hash and author

say_en.text: Squash these two commits with a fixup
say_en.note: Creates a fixup commit, then autosquash rebase
